377:t_10:37.en:
$$シモン$$
「This time even I could tell what he was saying.」

378:t_000:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I've caught up! Looks like whoever took the $$Ｖコン$$ still isn't used to piloting!」

378:t_001:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「If they're showing up at this exact moment, are they connected to whoever took the $$Ｖコン$$!?」

378:t_001:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$正太郎$$! Leave those guys to us!」

378:t_001:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You go after the culprit who stole the $$Ｖコン$$, together with $$タケル$$ and $n!」

378:t_002:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Then focus on the small fry around us!」

378:t_002:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Wait! I'm detecting a high energy reading from $$鉄人$$!」

378:t_003:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's solar energy! But the power is off the charts!」

378:t_003:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「This power...! It's the same as when the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ was defeated!」

378:t_003:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is someone trying to make $$鉄人$$'s solar energy go out of control!?」

378:t_003:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Can you hear me, $$０８$$! It's up to you to stop $$鉄人$$'s Solar Energy Conversion Device!」

378:t_003:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's no good...! Never mind stopping $$鉄人$$, if this keeps up, $$０８$$ inside won't hold out either!」

378:t_003:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If $$鉄人$$ explodes like this, this whole area will be reduced to ash!」

378:t_003:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「It's like a sun that has come down to earth...!」

378:t_003:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「This is bad! There's a town a little way from here!」

378:t_003:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then if we leave $$鉄人$$ alone like this, it'll swallow that town in a huge explosion...!?」

378:t_003:11.en:
$$シンジ$$
「We have to stop it before that...」

378:t_003:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$鉄人$$ is $$正太郎$$'s precious partner! It can't be allowed to hurt anyone!」

378:t_003:14.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's right! We're going to stop $$鉄人$$!」

378:t_003:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「You bet! When it comes to a contest of heat, I can't afford to lose!」

378:t_003:17.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To do that, we have to break through the enemy units around us...!」

378:t_003:18.en:
$$勝平$$
「That robot army! Did they follow us here!?」

378:t_003:19.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「They just never learn! And we thrashed them so thoroughly!」

378:t_003:20.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The calculation is done. For the time being, $$鉄人$$ is not likely to explode within four minutes.」

378:t_003:21.en:
$$万丈$$
「Understood. Then we'll clear out the robot army within four minutes!」

378:t_003:22.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Watch this, $$タケル$$! We'll smash those guys and chase away your worries!」

378:t_003:23.en:
$$葵$$
(The one behind that robot army... Is that the cold, dark gloom $$タケル$$ talked about...?)

378:t_004:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I've cleared out the small fry around us!」

378:t_005:1.en:
$$木下$$
「W-we can't get anywhere near $$鉄人$$ like this!」

378:t_005:2.en:
$$柿小路$$
「We have no choice but to do it! This is no time for whining, I tell you!」

378:t_005:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We'll do our best too! So... hurry up, $$正太郎$$!」

378:t_006:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「With this, one of the accursed powers of light will vanish!」

378:t_006:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's a double of $$皇帝ズール$$!」

378:t_006:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...All units, recover $$正太郎$$ and the others and fall back.」

378:t_006:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「If $$鉄人$$ explodes, even the nearby town won't be safe!」

378:t_006:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...There is nothing we can do.」

378:t_007:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That $$スペースロボ$$! It's $$グーラ$$!」

378:t_008:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Demon Beast Prince! What are you planning to do!?」

378:t_008:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「If you also wield the power of darkness, you should understand.」

378:t_008:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「With the black hole I create, I'll absorb $$鉄人$$'s solar energy!」

378:t_008:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Fool! A power like yours could never do such a thing!」

378:t_008:5.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Either the solar energy burns you to death, or you fail to control the black hole and get swallowed up yourself!」

378:t_008:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I am the Space Demon King's son, $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$! I'll pull it off!」

378:t_010:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Nice one, $$グーラ$$! A great victory, and you risked your life for it!」

378:t_010:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I learned this way of fighting from you.」

378:t_011:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You come too, $$オックス$$! We'll fight together with $$鉄人$$!」

378:t_013:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゲシュタルト$$... no, $$ズール$$! No matter how many robot armies you send out, don't think you can defeat us!」

378:t_013:1.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Robot army...? Don't lump those pitiful puppets in with my power, $$マーズ$$!」
